title: Fix ShortSport message sharing — receiver cannot open sent ShortSport

requirements.summary: Enable receiver to open and play the specific shared ShortSport video when tapping a message containing a shared post
acceptanceCriteria: When a receiver taps a shared ShortSport in their message thread, the specific ShortSport video plays/opens.
The correct post (the one that was shared) is displayed — not a generic feed or an empty/error state.
If ShortSportPage is used, it scrolls to and focuses the specific shared post by its post ID.
No error or blank screen is shown when the receiver opens a shared ShortSport message.

file_operations.description: Update the message rendering logic in the message thread view to detect when a message contains a postId field (indicating a shared ShortSport). Render a tappable preview card for video/ShortSport posts with a thumbnail, play icon, and caption excerpt. On tap, navigate to /shortsport?postId=<id> using the router's navigate function. Ensure this works for both sender and receiver messages in the thread.

Add logic to read the postId query parameter from the URL on component mount using the urlParams utility or useSearch hook. When postId is present, fetch that specific post using the backend actor and prepend it to the feed array so it displays first and auto-plays. If the postId does not match any loaded post or fetch fails, fall back gracefully to the normal newest-first feed without crashing. Preserve existing feed ordering and auto-advance behavior when no postId parameter is present.

requirements.summary: Render tappable ShortSport preview cards in message threads and navigate to ShortSportPage with postId parameter
acceptanceCriteria: Shared ShortSport messages in the thread render a recognizable preview (thumbnail or play icon) that is tappable.
Tapping the preview navigates to /shortsport with the correct postId parameter.
ShortSportPage reads the postId parameter on mount and scrolls/focuses to that specific post.
Works for both the sender and receiver side of the conversation.

file_operations.description: Create a new MessageBubble component that accepts a Message object as props. If the message has a postId field, fetch the post details using useQuery and render a compact video preview card with thumbnail (from post.media.getDirectURL()), a play icon overlay, and the post caption. Include a tap handler that navigates to /shortsport?postId=<postId>. For text-only messages, render the content as before. Style the bubble appropriately for sender vs receiver (align left/right, different background colors).

Replace the existing message rendering logic in the message thread section with the new MessageBubble component. Pass each message object to MessageBubble, which will handle rendering text messages vs shared post previews. Ensure the message list is scrollable and displays messages in chronological order. Wire the MessageBubble component into the JSX where messages are currently mapped.

requirements.summary: Update ShortSportPage to accept and handle an optional postId URL query parameter
acceptanceCriteria: ShortSportPage reads ?postId=<id> from the URL on mount.
When postId is present, the matching ShortSport is the first item shown and auto-plays.
If the postId does not match any loaded post, the page falls back to the normal newest-first feed without crashing.
When no postId is present, ShortSportPage behaves exactly as before (no regression).

file_operations.description: At the top of the ShortSportPage component, read the postId query parameter using useSearch from TanStack Router or the urlParams utility. If postId is present, use a separate useQuery hook to fetch the specific post by ID from the backend. Once fetched, prepend that post to the beginning of the posts array before rendering. Set the initial currentIndex to 0 so the shared post is the first video shown and auto-plays. Handle loading and error states gracefully: if the postId fetch fails or returns null, log a warning and fall back to the normal feed without the prepended post. Ensure the existing feed logic (newest-first, auto-advance on video end) is preserved when no postId parameter is present.

Add a helper function getPostIdFromUrl() that extracts the postId query parameter from the current URL (checking both ?postId= and #postId= formats). Return the postId as a bigint or null if not present. This utility will be used by ShortSportPage to detect the shared post parameter.
